critical_code_review_comments: Note (non-blocking, intentional behavior): GalleryManager.seedFor() shows the legacy day.image as a 'virtual' thumbnail before any save. The first upload's backend response replaces local state with whatever the server returns (POST upload appends to the persisted doc only). This means the visual seed thumb is not persisted unless an actual upload is performed — which is fine and expected for the dynamic-vs-fallback model.

DELETE /api/day-galleries/{key} is open (no auth) consistent with /api/slots. Acceptable per product spec but worth noting: anyone can wipe a gallery without admin token. Consider adding admin auth later if needed.
Upload endpoint converts PNGs to .webp server-side (good for storage). URL format is /api/files/xaluca/day-galleries/<key>/<hash>.webp — relative-safe handling via resolveGalleryUrl works.
seed_data_creation: Created day_galleries doc for key viajes.atlas_desierto.programa_4n_5d.day.dia-1 during testing. CLEANED UP at end (DELETE 200, bulk list count=0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Travel Image Library feature is fully functional. Endpoints: GET /api/day-galleries (bulk), GET/PUT/DELETE /api/day-galleries/{key}, POST /api/day-galleries/{key}/upload. Frontend at /admin → tab 'Galerías' (data-testid admin-tab-galleries). Day-key format: <ns>.day.<dayId>, e.g. viajes.atlas_desierto.programa_4n_5d.day.dia-1. Public itinerary page reflects dynamic gallery instantly; unedited days fall back to legacy 10-slot gallery.
